name: Local Embeddings
description: Provide a local model embedding adapter with explicit model dependencies.

external_services.name: Hugging Face model hub (initial model download only)
external_services.notes: Model id has no default. Set TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 to forbid any network access.

install: Install the optional dependencies first with: uv add sentence-transformers
missing_dependency_message: local-embeddings requires 'sentence-transformers', which is not installed. Install it with: uv add sentence-transformers
